newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX shies off 2,900 pts, but uptrend seen.
newsitem.headline: German DAX shies off 2,900 pts, but uptrend seen.

text.p: Germany's blue-chip DAX index failed to regain the prized 2,900-point level on Tuesday, but dealers noted that the market had performed solidly through the day and may be poised for more gains.
Much would depend on Wall Street's next move, with German market players keen to see a confirmation that last week's sharp stock tumble is firmly out of the way.
The 30-share IBIS DAX index was up 16.79 points at 2,887.09 points at 1501 GMT, after the DAX closed the bourse session mid-afternoon at 2,891.00.
Initial gains on Wall Street were helping the market.
Chemicals remained in centre stage in afternoon trade after Hoechst AG raced to a record high after announcing plans to merge its specialty chemicals business with Swiss group Clariant AG.
The stock was still well outperforming the market to trade up 2.08 marks at 70.85 marks in afternoon dealings.

Auto shares showed a more muted performance, performing in line with the market trend, despite a stream of reports about Volkswagen AG's ongoing feud with General Motors and about possible leadership changes at Mercedes-Benz, Daimler-Benz AG's luxury car-making unit.
